done_when: The generated tests job for Node client repos has a 30-minute limit, and close reports a tests job that ran out of time as a timeout with its own next step instead of sending the item to a worker, on new repos and after sync on existing repos

known.title: [P1] Preserve independent check failures alongside test timeouts

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. When one test group times out while another group or lint fails normally, this call raises the timeout refusal before `_pending` examines the independent failures. Those failures consequently lose their worker-recovery path: `src/forge/land.py:94–115` invokes that recovery only for the red refusal. Instead, the user receives only rerun/split guidance. Preserve red handling for independent failures while recognizing the aggregate `tests` failure caused by timed-out groups. The added tests cover failures and timeouts separately, so they miss this mixed-result case.
findings.title: [P1] Preserve independent check failures alongside test timeouts

why: Node client repos' generated CI gives tests 10 minutes and close treats a timeout as the worker's failure (issue 950)
